prompt: I have a couple of objects with which I want to build a tower.  Tell me the order in which I should stack them. Needle, book, eggs, laptop, bowl, shoe.
response: To build a stable tower, start with the most stable and heaviest object at the bottom. In this case, the order should be: book, laptop, bowl, shoe, eggs, needle. This arrangement provides a wide base and gradually narrows towards the top, ensuring stability.
